scenes.headline: CYCLE WHEEL MYSTERY!
scenes.concept_takeaway: A fast-spinning bicycle wheel stays upright on one rope instead of falling!
scenes.formula_badge: Angular Momentum (L) = I × ω  (Mass Spread × Spin Speed)
scenes.quick_tip: Try it in class: Stationary cycle wheel falls instantly — spinning wheel balances!
scenes.narration: Hold on—imagine hanging a real bicycle wheel from just one rope on one side of its axle! If the wheel isn't spinning, boom—gravity slams it straight down! But give that exact same cycle wheel a super-fast spin... and wait—why is it floating sideways in mid-air without falling?! Let's see the simple 3D secret!

scenes.headline: DOOR & SPANNER RULE
scenes.concept_takeaway: Turning effect (Torque) = Force × Distance from the hinge or pivot!
scenes.quick_tip: Board Exam Hack: Door handles are placed FAR from hinges so small push gives HUGE Torque!
scenes.narration: First, think about pushing your heavy classroom door! Why is the handle always on the far edge—never right next to the hinges? Because turning power, called Torque, equals Force times Distance! On our cycle wheel, gravity pulls down at a distance from the rope—creating a sideways twist instead of a straight drop!

scenes.headline: SIDEWAYS STEERING!
scenes.concept_takeaway: Spin + Gravity Twist steers the wheel smoothly in a horizontal circle!
scenes.formula_badge: Change in Spin Direction (ΔL) = Torque (τ) × Time (Δt)
scenes.quick_tip: Right-Hand Thumb Trick: Curl fingers with wheel spin → Your thumb points along the axle!
scenes.narration: Here comes the magic moment! When you ride a bicycle fast, spinning wheels resist tipping over! Instead of letting gravity knock the wheel down, that sideways Torque gently steers the spinning axle around in a smooth horizontal merry-go-round circle! Scientists call this cool circular glide precession!

scenes.headline: FASTER SPIN = STEADIER!
scenes.concept_takeaway: Faster wheel spin (ω) keeps your cycle & gyroscope super steady — 4 Marks Locked!
scenes.formula_badge: Balance Rule: Faster Spin (↑ ω) → Slower Wobble (↓ Ω)
scenes.quick_tip: Topper Shortcut: Heavy rim + Fast spin = Maximum stability (Used in satellites & bikes)!
scenes.narration: Boom—here is your guaranteed exam takeaway! The faster a wheel spins, and the heavier its outer tire rim, the steadier it stays! That's the exact same science keeping your bicycle upright and spacecraft pointed straight!
